'''David Lakin Harrison''' (1 October 1926 – 19 March 2015) was an English [[zoologist]] who established, with his family, the Harrison Zoological Museum, later known as the [[Harrison Institute]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/obituaries/11525403/David-Harrison-zoologist-obituary.html|title=David Harrison, zoologist - obituary|date=9 April 2015|work=Telegraph.co.uk|accessdate=13 April 2015}}</ref>
